outcome: GitHub Actions monitoring has been removed from the ChatGPT execution path.
owner_impact: After a task's terminal commit, ChatGPT no longer waits for, polls, checks, or monitors Actions at all. GitHub CI independently builds, deploys, runs the manifest-driven current-Lab smoke suite, and sends you one bot-authored success or failure email.
remaining_action: None for the anti-stall mechanism. Future product work can resume with Actions fully asynchronous to the assistant.
technical_evidence: AGENTS.md and CURRENT.md now forbid even one proactive workflow-run/job/log/queue/status check after a GitHub write that can trigger Actions.
The main CI workflow now owns terminal success/failure reporting directly from this structured report.
The separate success-report-notifier workflow was removed.
A regression test prevents the old agent-monitoring rules or legacy notifier workflow from returning.
